verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Josafat chi' t'a spalacio t'a Jerusalén.

Ix elta winhaj Jehú schekab' Dios yuninal winhaj Hanani scha winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix ach kolwaj yet' jun winh chuk spensar chi'? ¿Tas yuj wach' ak'an yet' jun winh ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová? Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal Jehová t'ayach.
Palta jun, ayto wal juntzanhxo tas wach' yoch a wach'ilok, yujto ix a satel yechel Asera t'a yol a makb'en tik, ix ak'anpaxoch t'a a k'ol ak'an serwil Dios, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh.

Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan winhaj Josafat chi', palta ay jun smodo winh, to sb'at winh yil juntzanhxo schonhab', schakot winh t'a Beerseba, masanto sk'ek'och winh t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Tz'ek' winh yik syak'xioch sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.
Ix ak'jioch heb' winh juez yuj winh t'a junjun chonhab' ayoch smuro'al ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh juez chi' icha tik: Scham wal eyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto manhok tas snib'ej heb' anima ol he k'ulej, palta to a wal tas snib'ej Jehová. Ol ochnhej Jehová chi' heyet'ok yik tze b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima.

Yuj chi', niwanokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, scham wal eyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, manh ol techaj yuj tato ay tas manh wach'ok ol he k'ulej, tato ay sk'exanhil anima t'a yol he sat, mato ol he cha k'e'en tumin t'a elk'altak, xchi winh.

Hanhejtona' ix sik'anpaxelta juntzanh heb' winh levita winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' juntzanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', yik tz'och heb' winh juezal yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj heb' winh t'a sley Jehová yet' yik sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima chi' heb' winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix yak'ankan juntzanh cheknab'il tik winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex tik, ol eyil eyopisio tik, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, tze k'anab'ajani, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a.

Yalnhej tas yaj yowal heb' ketchonhab' tik, ol jawok heb' t'ayex, ma yuj heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', tato ha' yuj junok lolonel, ma yuj mak'ojcham anima, ma juntzanhxo tas tz'el sk'ulan heb' to manh ichaok yalan sley Jehová, tze b'o yaj t'a heb'. Scham wal he kachan heb' yik max och smul heb' t'a Jehová, yik max kot yowal t'a eyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb'. Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yik manh ol och he mul.

Ha winhaj Amarías sat sacerdote yaji, anhej winh syal yalani tas ol aj sb'o tastak yik Jehová. Haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Ismael, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá, anhej winh syal yalan tas ol aj pax yik winh rey yaji. Ol kolwaj pax heb' winh levita heyet'ok. Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, ak'ek eyip t'a eyopisio tik. Ha mach wach'nhej tas ol sk'ulej, ol ochnhej Jehová yet'ok, xchi winh.
